text:
Nora (People Ops): Hey EMEA folks  heads up: our Lisbon engineering offsite (Oct 12-14) is confirmed. We opened travel stipends, a small family travel credit, and an optional carbon-offset top-up. RSVP and travel page here: https://travel.redwood.example/lisbon-offsite :sun_with_face:

Diego (Events): Venue: LX Factory - workshop rooms and rooftop dinner on Oct 13. Day 0 meetup drinks Oct 11 evening (informal). Schedule + local transport tips on the event page.

Ana (Finance): Stipend summary:
- Standard travel stipend (EMEA): EUR 220
- Long-haul top-up (flights >4h): EUR 120
- Family travel credit: up to EUR 300 if bringing partner + child care receipts accepted
- Carbon offset top-up (opt-in): EUR 15 matched by company if you opt in at booking

Owen (Legal): Visa note for non-EU passport holders: People Ops will issue invitation letters for visa purposes. DM with passport name, nationality, and travel dates. Allow 4-6 weeks for processing in some countries.

Nora (People Ops): Remote option: keynotes will be streamed; workshops are in-person only but we'll run remote breakout rooms for at least two workshops. Mark "remote" on the RSVP if you're joining virtually.

TransitBot: Local transit alert: Lisbon tram #28 may be crowded during morning tourist hours. Allow an extra 25 minutes for commutes near Alfama.

Diego (Events): Accommodation options: company room block at Hotel LX Lisbon (block closes Sep 22). Alternative partner spaces: coworking day pass at Second Home Lisboa (book via RSVP). If block sells out, email events@redwood.ai and we'll add overflow hotels.

Ana (Finance): Expense policy reminders:
- Submit receipts within 30 days of travel.
- Use category "Offsite - Lisbon 2026" in the expense system.
- Family credit requires receipts listing traveler name + relation.

Nora (People Ops): Accessibility + dietary: venue is wheelchair accessible. Vegetarian/vegan/kosher/halal options available  note on RSVP. We also booked a quiet room for neurodivergent teammates (capacity limited)  mark "quiet" on RSVP to reserve.

Owen (Legal): Data/recording: do not photograph attendee badges or whiteboards with sensitive info. If you plan to record a workshop, get speaker consent and post to the internal drive with access controls.

Diego (Events): Logistics for demo gear: small gear allowed in checked rooms; for anything >25kg or rack-sized email events-logistics@redwood.ai by Sep 30. We'll provide a loading window and dolly.

Nora (People Ops): Family travel example to paste into expense form:
```
Expense: Family travel credit
Amount: EUR 220.00
Date: 2026-10-12
Category: Offsite - Lisbon 2026
Notes: Partner travel credit - receipt attached (partner name: Maria Silva)
```

Ana (Finance): Carbon offset: if you opt-in during booking, select "Offset + company match" and we'll reimburse the matched EUR 15 automatically; no manual receipt needed.

TransitBot: Shuttle service planned from Cais do Sodré station to LX Factory Oct 12-13 at 08:15 and 08:45. Return shuttles 17:30 and 18:00. Priority for teammates with mobility needs.

Diego (Events): Socials: rooftop dinner Oct 13 (all attendees welcome). If you'd like a plus-one for the dinner only (not travel reimbursement), add "dinner plus-one" to RSVP. Dinner plus-one is limited and on a first-come basis.

Owen (Legal): Health/safety: check region travel advisories for your passport country. If you require medical accommodations (dietary, meds storage), note it in RSVP and People Ops will follow up.

Nora (People Ops): RSVP deadline Sep 25. If you need expedited visa docs earlier, DM me and we'll prioritize. Reminder: submit receipts within 30 days after travel. See you (hopefully) in Lisbon  or online! :airplane:
